analyst_view.overall: Early view: a Game 3 at SeatGeek Stadium on Wednesday 2 December, only played if the series is level at 1-1; kick-off time is still to be set and a draw after 90 minutes goes to penalties. It would be the third meeting in ten days, four days after Game 2 in Charlotte, with Chicago likely still without Rogers, Lod and Pineda. This view is very provisional and will be rebuilt from the first two games.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.6 goals, the same as Game 1. I lean a little lower for a winner-take-all third game: the teams will know each other well after two meetings, legs will be heavy four days after Game 2, and a conference semifinal place tends to make both sides careful until someone scores.

corners.text: The site expects 10.3 corners with most for Chicago at home. A deciding game could see Chicago push more, but I have nothing specific to go on, so I stay with the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards. I lean higher for a third meeting in ten days with elimination on the line; Chicago were booked three times in their last league game and Saint-Maximin was sent off at Orlando in October.

shots.text: The site expects 30.7 shots, with almost 21 for Chicago. Even in a decider that looks high for a Chicago side without Lod and Pineda that had 14 shots against Columbus, so I lean lower.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.9 on target. I lean slightly lower for a tense decider where defences are likely to sit deeper, though both attacks have been accurate recently.
